svg.title: Froni Edition One, printed care, fibre, origin, and wordmark tape
svg.desc: Nominal tape width 30 mm; final width set at pre-production per the pack. EB Garamond outlines. FRONI at 5 mm caps, tracked. Fibre lines in German with English additions per TextilKennzG paragraph 4. Care wording per the pack. Print color decided with the factory tape proof.
